newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day Cetes rates down on primary plunge.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day Cetes rates down on primary plunge.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate opened down 85 basis points at 26.55 percent on Wednesday in the wake of plummeting primary rates, traders said.
"Primary rates fell by more than was expected, but the market is still liquid. The fact that the peso is firm despite the fall is helping matters," said a trader.
Banco de Mexico assigned bellwether 28-day Cetes rates at 27.02 percent at Tuesday night's primary auction of government securities, a fall of 206 basis points from last week's rate.
A Reuters survey of ten money market traders conducted on Tuesday showed they had expected rates to fall by an average of 142 basis points.
Dealers said most demand was from foreign investors picking up paper at current rates before an expected drop in inflation next year.
Overnight rates on bank paper were 95 basis points off at 27.60 percent.
Credit maturities were expected to total 7.500 billion pesos.
